notes: SnapshotBaseline.toMatch(bytes, name): a .png name is compared by pixels and any other extension, JPEG included, byte for byte. A string is compared with Vitest's own expect(text).toMatchFileSnapshot(path).

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; comparison by extension, keying, update modes and failure files checked against the upstream contract.

decision.quote: Text stays with Vitest's own `toMatchFileSnapshot`, which already diffs a string against a file
